_comment: The committed egress policy of the sandboxes.
app_spec.xml, Trust Zone Isolation & Secrets, feature 149:
System denies all egress from sandboxes by default, which rejects
any attempt to reach the data lake over the network
egress denied by default; section 1 P1: LLM-authored code has no
network path to the data snapshots; section 1 P4: the sandbox never
The compile in infra/security/sandbox_egress.py refuses this file
and any change to it that grants a sandbox any egress rule at all,
so the empty egress lists below are not a convention the next edit
can forget: they are the law, checked.
Addresses are examples for the zone's shape, not real ranges.
